content:
Updates the global agent configuration.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
object
Specifies settings for automatic unlinking of agents.
object
Specifies settings for controlling concurrent agent updates.
boolean
Enables or disables software updates for agents, subject to any
configured agent exclusions.
boolean
auto_unlink
concurrent_update
software_update
hybrid_scanning_enabled
Content type
Enables or disables hybrid scanning for agents.
